summary: Baosheng Media Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing proxy materials for an extraordinary general meeting on September 4, 2026. Proposals include increasing authorized share capital from US$9.6M to US$96M and re-classifying shares into Class A (9.9B) and Class B (100M) ordinary shares. This is a routine corporate governance matter, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or strategic action is involved. The filing only concerns capital structure changes and a meeting notice. Recommended category is None.
